concerns.text: Task T008 is marked `[S]` (stub) yet claims to satisfy FR‑001 and FR‑002. Providing a stub weakens the functional requirements; the task must deliver a full implementation to meet the spec.
Task T009 is marked `[S]` (stub) while intended to satisfy FR‑007 (ablation study). A stub does not fulfill the ablation requirement, constituting a weakening of the FR.
Task T011 is marked `[S]` (stub) but is responsible for FR‑008 (hard timeout and OOM fallback). A stub implementation cannot guarantee the required resource guards, thus weakening the FR.

Task T012 is marked `[S]` (stub) for the condition‑specific trainers. These trainers are essential for the training pipeline; a stub fails to meet the full training requirement and weakens the overall compliance with FR‑003/FR‑008.

Task T015’s orchestration script may offload fine‑tuning to a GPU escape hatch, violating Constitution Principle I (reproducibility on a fresh CPU‑only GitHub Actions runner). This introduces non‑deterministic hardware dependence.

Task T010 defines LoRA hyper‑parameters but does not enforce an explicit total effective batch size or memory ceiling, leaving FR‑003’s low‑memory constraint unchecked. Acceptance criteria for memory limits are missing.
